【典型触发场景】算一下保费费率 / 做产品定价 / 跑利润测试 / 算准备金 / 算内含价值 EV / 做分红险报备材料 / 红利利益演示 / 利差损诊断 / 财产车险定价 / 损失发展三角 / 准备金模型校准 / 对标人保财险商业车险案例。

【触发词】保费费率、产品定价、利润测试、准备金、内含价值、EV、NBV、VNB、IRR、利差损、监管报备、报备材料、精算报告、分红险演示、现金价值表、费率表、财产险定价、损失三角、商业车险。

【不在本技能内】保单销售建议 / 理赔纠纷分析 / 纯保险知识科普（不带测算）/ 个险核保结论 / 监管政策解读——请走其他路径。

[EN] Actuarial modeling skill: life insurance pricing (net premium, reserves, gross premium), per-1000 rate tables & cash value schedules, profit testing (NBV/VNB/IRR), reserve valuation under C-ROSS Phase II (BEL+RM), embedded value, P&C pricing & loss-triangle reserving, and regulatory filing generation. Ships with China's CL(2010-2013) 3rd and CL(2025) 4th mortality tables (param-switchable) plus a verified PICC commercial auto calibration case.

Capabilities: Big Five (OCEAN) trait estimation, self-presentation & self-monitoring (Goffman/Snyder), Higgins self-discrepancy, defense mechanisms (Vaillant), attachment and burnout signals, three-layer persona mapping (public persona / private self / self-reported), relationship-crisis attribution, and exploratory non-directive next-step discussion by scenario (workplace / dating / friendship / scam detection).
